full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Delwar Hossain, J:-This Rule was issued upon an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the delay of 178 days in filing the criminal appeal against the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 24.9.2008 passed by the Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 51h Court, Chittagong in Sessions Case No.1098 of 2002 should not be condoned and/or pass such other order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. In the application it has been stated that the petitioner after being enlarged on bail he regularly appeared before the trial court till 10.8.2008. Since the petitioner being a very poor person he went to Cox's Bazar in search of work and stayed there till he came back to Chittagong on 11.2.2009 when he was arrested by the police and produced before the trial court on 12.2.2009 wherefrom he was sent to jail to, suffer the sentence. After collecting the necessary papers through his tadbirkar engaged the learned Advocate who preparing the petition of appeal filed the same on 22.3.2009 and thereby a delay of 178 days has been caused. The said delay was unintentional and bonafide for which the application under section 5 of the Limitation Act has been filed for condoning the delay and obtained Rule on 21.4.2009.
